fact: TerraPay's network carries remittances from money-transfer operators in the US, Canada and Europe into Wave mobile wallets in Mali through a single integration, so users receive funds instantly.
source_slug: 2025-05-29 TerraPay enables cross-border remittances for Wave Mobile Money users in Mali

fact: Mali has 12 institutions on the BCEAO list authorised to open PI-SPI, the UEMOA regional instant payment platform, to the public as of 2 April 2026.
The World Bank says Mali's connection to the regional switch is inefficient but limits users of the payment system, implying participation in GIM-UEMOA, with the Public Treasury not yet connected.
Mali is a UEMOA member covered by PI-SPI, the regional instant payment system in service since 30 September 2025.
The BCEAO list places Mali in the eight-country WAEMU PI-SPI regional instant payment rail.
